boards.title: Claimed by 9am: 10 Study Spots Worth Showing Up Early For
boards.description: Ten documented F&M settings for quiet reading, collaborative work, writing, and subject-focused study. Confirm current building access before visiting.

cards.title: Settle In at Shadek-Fackenthal
cards.subtitle: Humanities, social sciences, and fine-arts collections
cards.notes: Start at the information desk, then choose a work area near the humanities, social-sciences, fine-arts, or media collections.
cards.short_summary: A collection-rich library setting for reading, research, and longer writing sessions.
cards.evidence_claim: F&M identifies Shadek-Fackenthal as a College Library location housing humanities, social-sciences, fine-arts, and media collections, plus several learning spaces and service desks.
cards.access_notes: Library access follows the College Library’s current schedule; check posted hours and entry requirements before visiting.

cards.title: Work Among the Science Collections
cards.subtitle: Science library with research and technology support
cards.notes: Bring a science-heavy assignment and use the nearby collections, Archives resources, or technology-support services as needed.
cards.short_summary: A science-centered library environment with research collections and technical support close at hand.
cards.evidence_claim: F&M states that Martin Library holds its science print collections and houses Archives & Special Collections, the ITS Help Desk, and the Tech Lending Center.
cards.access_notes: Library access follows the College Library’s current schedule; verify hours and any ID requirement before arrival.

cards.title: Use Bonchek’s Classroom or Lounge
cards.subtitle: Ground-floor commons in South Benjamin Franklin Hall
cards.notes: Choose the classroom for structured group work or move to the lounge when the assignment calls for a more conversational setup.
cards.short_summary: A residential commons pairing classroom space with a lounge, kitchen, and convenient ground-floor location.
cards.evidence_claim: F&M documents Bonchek College House Commons on South Benjamin Franklin Hall’s ground floor and says it includes a lounge, kitchen, and classroom.
cards.access_notes: This commons is inside first-year housing. Confirm residential-building entry and guest rules with Bonchek House staff.

cards.title: Spread Out Between Brooks Halls
cards.subtitle: Commons connecting Buchanan and Marshall Halls
cards.notes: Pick the classroom for a working session or use the lounge or fireplace room for reading and discussion between commitments.
cards.short_summary: A connecting commons with several distinct settings for solo preparation or small-group conversation.
cards.evidence_claim: F&M says Brooks College House Commons connects Buchanan and Marshall Halls and includes a lounge, fireplace room, kitchen, and classroom.
cards.access_notes: Located within first-year residential facilities; confirm building access and guest policies with Brooks House staff.

cards.title: Bookend Group Work at Roschel
cards.subtitle: Study rooms beside the first-floor Great Room
cards.notes: Use a study room off the Great Room for focused collaboration, and move to a floor lounge when a less formal setting fits.
cards.short_summary: Dedicated residential study rooms positioned beside Roschel’s main first-floor gathering space.
cards.evidence_claim: F&M documents study rooms off Roschel College House’s first-floor Great Room, along with common lounges on every floor.
cards.access_notes: Roschel is returning-student housing. Confirm entry, guest access, and study-room availability with House staff.

cards.title: Meet in Ware’s Ground-Floor Commons
cards.subtitle: Lounge and classroom in North Benjamin Franklin Hall
cards.notes: Use the classroom for organized project work, then shift to the lounge for review or discussion without changing buildings.
cards.short_summary: A ground-floor residential commons combining a classroom, lounge, and kitchen near the main dining hall.
cards.evidence_claim: F&M states that Ware College House Commons occupies North Benjamin Franklin Hall’s ground floor and includes a lounge, kitchen, and classroom.
cards.access_notes: This commons is within first-year housing. Ask Ware House staff about residential access and guest requirements.

cards.title: Match the Task to a Weis Room
cards.subtitle: Great room, seminar room, and living room in Weis Hall
cards.notes: Take discussion-based work to the seminar room, or choose the living room or great room for reading and collaborative review.
cards.short_summary: A multi-room commons that lets students select a formal seminar setup or a softer shared environment.
cards.evidence_claim: F&M says the renovated Weis College House Commons contains a large great room, seminar room, living room, and fully equipped kitchen.
cards.access_notes: Weis Hall is returning-student housing; verify building entry and guest rules with Weis House staff before meeting there.

cards.title: Draft Beside the Writers House Fireplace
cards.subtitle: Couches, books, and writing-focused classroom space
cards.notes: Bring a reading or draft, settle onto a couch, and check the event calendar so workshops or performances do not interrupt the session.
cards.short_summary: A house-scale literary setting suited to drafting, close reading, and publication work.
cards.evidence_claim: F&M describes Writers House as having comfortable couches, a kitchen, and fireplace, while serving as a classroom and home for student-run publications.
cards.access_notes: All are welcome to visit, but classes and events use the house; consult the current event schedule before settling in.

cards.title: Compare Problems in the Physics Lounge
cards.subtitle: Subject-focused lounge in Hackman Laboratories
cards.notes: Bring equations or lab notes for peer discussion; this lounge is specifically documented for physics majors to study and exchange ideas.
cards.short_summary: A discipline-specific collaboration space within F&M’s physical-sciences complex.
cards.evidence_claim: F&M states that Hackman Physical Sciences Laboratories contains a lounge where physics majors gather to study and share ideas.
cards.access_notes: The lounge is designated for physics majors. Academic-building student access is generally controlled by campus ID and schedule.

cards.title: Read by the Klehr Center Fireplace
cards.subtitle: Well-lit living room with a library and comfortable furniture
cards.notes: Choose the living room for reading or informal review, and check the program calendar before relying on the multipurpose areas.
cards.short_summary: A comfortable, well-lit study setting within F&M’s center for Jewish life and interfaith gathering.
cards.evidence_claim: F&M calls the Klehr Center ideal for studying and socializing and documents a living room with fireplace and comfortable furniture, a library, and multipurpose spaces.
cards.source_title: The Klehr Center for Jewish Life
cards.access_notes: Programs, classes, and religious activities may use the space; confirm current availability and entry arrangements with Klehr Center staff.
